name: Singapore
intro: Explore the Garden City, a clean, high-tech metropolis at the crossroads of Southeast Asia. Singapore blends futuristic green architecture, luxury retail, and rich multi-cultural neighborhoods.
bestSeason: February to April (Lowest rainfall) & September (Formula 1 Grand Prix)
weather: Hot and humid tropical climate. Constant 31°C year-round with short daily tropical rainfall.
visaInfo: Visa required prior to travel for Indian passport holders (e-Visa).
flightDuration: Approx 5-6 hours flight from New Delhi or Mumbai.
highlights: Marvel at the avatar-like Supertree Grove at Gardens by the Bay
Swim in the world-famous infinity pool atop Marina Bay Sands
Savor Michelin-starred street food at historic hawker centers
Take a night safari through the world's first nocturnal wildlife park

famousPlaces.name: Gardens by the Bay
famousPlaces.shortDesc: A futuristic horticultural wonderland featuring steel Supertrees and the world's largest glass greenhouse domes.
famousPlaces.overview: Gardens by the Bay spans 101 hectares of reclaimed land in central Singapore. The park features the Cloud Forest dome with a 35-meter indoor waterfall, the Flower Dome, and the soaring Supertree Grove connected by an aerial skyway.

hotels.name: Marina Bay Sands Hotel
hotels.description: Iconic luxury resort featuring the world's largest rooftop infinity pool.

famousPlaces.meals: Singaporean buffet breakfasts and private street-food hawker crawl.
famousPlaces.transport: Singapore MRT subway card and private chauffeur transfers.
famousPlaces.activities: Cloud Forest Dome Entry, Flower Dome Entry, OCBC Skyway Supertree Walk.
included: Marina Bay Sands club room stay
Fast-track entry to domes and skyway

faqs.q: Is the Sands infinity pool open to the public?
faqs.a: No, the rooftop infinity pool is strictly reserved for hotel guests.

reviews.author: Vijay S.
reviews.text: The Cloud Forest indoor waterfall is a marvel. Swimming in the Sands infinity pool at night is magical.

itinerary.title: Welcome to Singapore & Sands Pool
itinerary.morning: Airport pickup, check into Marina Bay Sands. Rest.
itinerary.afternoon: Swim in the rooftop infinity pool looking out over the skyline.
itinerary.evening: Guided street food tour tasting Hainanese chicken rice and chili crab at Newton Food Center.

itinerary.title: Gardens Domes & Supertree Light Show
itinerary.morning: Walk the massive glass conservatories, the Flower Dome and Cloud Forest.
itinerary.afternoon: Explore the modern art galleries inside the ArtScience Museum.
itinerary.evening: Watch the Garden Rhapsody light and sound show from the OCBC Skyway.
